name: autoflow/core-bundle
description: Symfony 7.4-compatible transport-neutral Clean Architecture foundation for AutoFlow microservices, with HTTP, serialization and optional RoadRunner gRPC adapters.

suggest.google/protobuf: Required when using the ProtobufSerializer adapter.
suggest.roadrunner/grpc: Required when using the RoadRunner gRPC server adapter.
suggest.roadrunner/http: Required when using the RoadRunner HTTP worker adapter.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: Required by the RoadRunner HTTP worker adapter.
suggest.symfony/psr-http-message-bridge: Required by the RoadRunner HTTP worker adapter.
